Efter alla block har vektorn för ”på” få: After all the blocks, the vector for “på” has picked up the context from the other words. The last row is now enough to guess the continuation.
Ett block ger en enda runda: varje token: One block gives a single round: each token can fetch information from other tokens and process it once, but never build further on what it fetched.
Några få rundor räcker för enkla samband: A few rounds are enough for simple connections, such as linking “den” to “Katten”. Longer chains of inference do not fit.
Fler rundor ger utrymme för kedjor: förs: More rounds make room for chains: first find what “den” refers to, then what is known about it, then what usually follows.
L = {{n}}. Varje token passerar alla blo: L = {{n}}. Every token passes through all the blocks in turn. The blocks cannot run in parallel for the same token, because each block needs the previous block’s result.
The starting point: five integers, one per token. No vectors yet.
Varje id blir en rad med 4096 tal. Här f: Each id becomes a row of 4096 numbers. This is where the stream x is born.
Block 1 har adderat två bidrag. Innehåll: Block 1 has added two contributions. The content has changed, the shape has not.
Samma shape igen. Därför kan block 2:s u: The same shape again. That is why the output of block 2 can go straight into block 3.
29 block till, alla med samma in- och ut: 29 more blocks, all with the same input and output shape.

Strömmen normaliseras en enda gång. Fort: The stream is normalized a single time. Still the same shape.
Här, och först här, byter shapen form: 4: Here, and only here, the shape changes form: 4096 numbers per row become 128,256, one per token in the vocabulary.
För att generera behövs bara raden för s: To generate, only the row for the last token is needed. It goes to sampling.
<b>Post-norm</b>: strömmen själv normali: Post-norm: the stream itself is normalized after every addition, so it is held at size 1 all the way. The direct path through the stream is disturbed in every block, which makes very deep models harder to train.
